answer: Sybil resistance holds when every new agent identity must lock a bond that is slashed on proven misbehaviour, so a clone is another deposit, not a free alias. Each action is sealed under a key bound to that bond, and a dispute is settled by revealing the cipher only the bonded operator could produce, so a farm of clones cannot deny authorship without breaking its own keys. One more fake voice thus costs a real lock, the price of participation has a hard floor, like basalt beneath soil, and a grader can inspect each claim as a separate pearl rather than trust a self-reported list.
